run_rerank_text: run text-only reranking via the /rerank endpoint to rank documents by relevance to a query
run_score_text: run text-only scoring via the /score endpoint to compute relevance scores for query-document pairs
run_score_text_top_n: run reranking with top_n filtering to return only the most relevant documents
run_main: run the full example script to execute reranking, scoring, and top-n filtering sequentially
run_colqwen3_5_rerank: run ColQwen3.5 late interaction model for reranking and scoring against a vLLM server
